_about: The AI Store catalog: every model and maker the store offers, with its details. Read by the AI machine (ai/gate) and by Orbit (the Store app). Sizes are bytes.

chat.title: Qwen 3.8 27B
chat.blurb: Best all-rounder. Sees images, uses tools, thinks step by step.
chat.about: The default model on your machine. Strong at everyday questions, writing, documents and photos, and it can think through harder problems before answering.
tryIt: Explain this photo of my fridge and suggest dinner
Plan a 3-day trip to Lisbon on a budget

chat.title: Qwen 3.6 35B (coder)
chat.blurb: Fast mixture-of-experts model, strongest for code and agents.
chat.about: Only a small part of the model works on each word, so it answers quickly for its size. The best pick for code, the Antigravity agent and anything that uses tools.
tryIt: Write a Python script that renames photos by date
Find the bug in this function

chat.title: Qwen 3.8 27B OBLITERATED
chat.about: Qwen 3.8 with its refusals removed, in a high-quality 6-bit size. Adults only: it will not lecture or decline.
tryIt: Write a dark, gritty crime scene

chat.title: Qwen 3.8 27B abliterated (huihui)
chat.blurb: Popular uncensored Qwen 3.8 that keeps image understanding. Smaller 4-bit.
chat.about: An uncensored Qwen 3.8 that can still look at pictures. Smaller than OBLITERATED, so it loads faster.
tryIt: Describe this picture honestly, no filter

chat.title: Defiant Fable 9B
chat.blurb: Small, very fast uncensored storyteller. Good for role-play and quick chats.
chat.about: A small storyteller tuned for fiction and role-play. Very quick, and happy to go where the story goes.
tryIt: Start a noir story set in a rainy harbour town

chat.title: Gemma 4 31B
chat.blurb: Google's strongest open all-rounder: sees images, uses tools, many languages.
chat.about: A big, careful all-rounder from Google. Reads photos and documents, follows instructions closely and writes well in dozens of languages.
tryIt: Summarise this contract in plain words
Translate this menu photo into English

chat.title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B
chat.blurb: Quick mixture-of-experts Gemma that sees images; snappy replies.
chat.about: Only a few of its experts work on each word, so it answers fast while still seeing pictures and speaking many languages.
tryIt: What breed is the dog in this photo?

chat.title: Gemma 4 12B
chat.blurb: Small, fast and sharp, with image understanding.
chat.about: Loads in seconds and answers quickly. Good for everyday questions, quick translations and reading screenshots.
tryIt: Rewrite this email to sound friendlier

chat.title: Muse Glimmer 30B
chat.blurb: Built for agents: reliable tool calls, multi-step plans, reads screenshots, 100+ languages.
chat.about: Made to get things done: it plans in steps, calls tools reliably and can read a screenshot of what it is working on.
tryIt: Plan my week from these three emails
Find what is wrong in this screenshot

chat.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B
chat.blurb: NVIDIA's fast thinker; strong at tool use and long documents.
chat.about: Thinks before it answers, but quickly. Very long memory, so it handles big documents and long sessions.
tryIt: Work out the cheapest way to ship 40 boxes to Spain

chat.title: LFM2.5 24B-A2B
chat.blurb: Very fast reasoning agent that speaks 16 languages.
chat.about: A light, very fast model from Liquid AI that can still think through problems and use tools.
tryIt: Explain compound interest in Spanish

chat.title: MiMo V2.6 Distill 9B
chat.blurb: Small, quick thinker for code and tools.
chat.about: A small model taught by a much bigger one. Quick to load and surprisingly good at step-by-step problems and code.
tryIt: Write a regex that matches UK postcodes

chat.title: Tiel Coder 35B-A3B
chat.blurb: Fast coding agent that fixes real bugs in real codebases.
chat.about: A coding specialist tuned to work like an agent: read the code, find the bug, fix it, run the tests.
tryIt: Find why this test fails and fix it

chat.title: Qwen3 Coder 30B-A3B
chat.about: A tried-and-tested coder from the Ollama library: quick, steady, great at writing and explaining code.
tryIt: Turn this script into a command-line tool

chat.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Heretic
chat.about: Qwen 3.8 with refusals removed by the Heretic method, which keeps more of the original smarts than older methods.
tryIt: Write the villain’s monologue, no holding back

chat.title: Ortenzya 31B
chat.blurb: Uncensored Gemma 4 tuned for stories, role-play and translation.
chat.about: A wordsmith: rich prose, strong characters and dialogue, no refusals. Can also look at a picture for inspiration.
tryIt: Write the opening of a gothic novel set in Lisbon

chat.title: Artemis 31B v1.2
chat.blurb: Role-play and creative-writing finetune from TheDrummer.
chat.about: Plays characters and keeps a story going over long sessions, with lively, natural dialogue.
tryIt: You are a ship’s captain in a storm. Stay in character.

chat.title: Orion 26B-A4B v1.1
chat.about: The quick sibling of Artemis: storytelling and role-play with fast replies.
tryIt: Continue the story: the lighthouse light went out at midnight

qwen.about: The built-in picture maker. Strong at following long descriptions and at writing real words inside pictures (signs, posters, labels).
tryIt: A neon “OPEN 24H” sign over a rainy diner, cinematic
A children’s book page: a fox reading under a tree

qwen-real.about: A Qwen-Image finetune for photoreal people and places: skin, light and lenses that look like a camera took them.
tryIt: Street portrait of an old fisherman at golden hour, 85 mm

anime.about: Anime and illustration: clean line art, cel shading and lively colour.
tryIt: A girl with a red umbrella on a rooftop, anime key visual

krea-real.about: Krea 2 tuned for photographs, and fast: only 8 steps. Takes the style add-ons below.
tryIt: Moody film photo of a jazz bar, grain, warm light

ltx.output: Video with sound, 25 fps, up to 10 s
ltx.about: The built-in video maker: moving pictures with matching sound, from words or from a starting picture.
tryIt: Waves crashing on black rocks at dusk, seagulls, wind

h3-max.about: The best motion: people and animals move naturally, with sound. A larger download.
tryIt: A dancer spinning in a sunlit studio, slow motion

edit.about: Change a picture by describing the change. Uses the built-in Qwen model.
tryIt: Make it night with a full moon
Change the jacket to red leather

outfit.about: Dress the person in picture 1 in the outfit from picture 2.

angles.about: The same subject from another camera angle.
tryIt: Turn the camera 45 degrees to the left
View from above

sharpen.about: Makes a picture four times larger and crisper. No description needed.

style-softwatercolor.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

style-retroanime.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

style-darkbrush.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

style-neondrip.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

style-vintagetarot.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

style-rainywindow.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

style-sunsetblur.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

style-dotmatrix.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

style-kidsdrawing.about: Lay this look over Krea Real. It switches on with its trigger words, which Orbit adds for you.

qwen-turbo.about: The official fast version of the built-in picture maker. Same look in a third of the time. Filtered, not uncensored.

viggle-turbo.about: Qwen-Image distilled to 6 steps: pictures in a few seconds with nearly the same quality.

krea-hd.about: A Krea 2 finetune for fine detail: skin, fabric, brushwork.

krea-moody.about: An uncensored Krea 2 blend with deep shadows and a film look.

ltx-official.about: The original LTX-2.3 from its makers: follows your words closely. Filtered.

h3-beta6.about: The newer 10Eros Max, best when you start from a picture.

h3-cobijada.about: An uncensored H3 blend that keeps first and last frames faithful.

h3-singularity.about: Tuned for sharp, HDR-looking video with good faces at a distance, action and magic effects.

h3-official.about: The stock H3 model with a speed-up. Filtered.

restore.about: Bring old or damaged photos back: removes blur, noise, scratches and fading.
tryIt: Restore the old photo: remove scratches, dust and fading, keep the people and colours

exposure.trigger: Transform the image with balanced neutral exposure
exposure.about: Fixes photos that are too dark or too bright. Experimental.

next-scene.about: Makes the next frame of a story from your picture: describe the camera move first, then what changes.
tryIt: The camera pulls back to a wide shot as rain begins

clay.trigger: Transform the image into a clay sculpture style
clay.about: Your picture as a hand-modelled clay sculpture.

ultrasharp.about: The classic: crisp, clean enlargements, especially of compressed JPEGs.

ultrasharp2.about: A newer, cleaner all-rounder for photos, art, anime and text. Slower than V1.

clearreality.about: A soft, natural look for faces, hair and nature. Very fast.

animesharp.about: Faithful enlargement for anime and drawings: clean lines, no smearing.

style-baroqueoil.about: Lay a baroque oil look over Krea Real. Its trigger words are added for you.

style-linocut.about: Lay a ink linocut look over Krea Real. Its trigger words are added for you.

style-paperdiorama.about: Lay a paper diorama look over Krea Real. Its trigger words are added for you.

style-celshaded.about: Lay a cel shaded look over Krea Real. Its trigger words are added for you.

ltx-25.license: LTX-2.x Community (free under $10M a year in revenue)
ltx-25.output: Video with sound, 24 fps, up to 10 s
ltx-25.about: The newest LTX: sharper motion and sound than 2.3. Start from words, a photo, a first and last photo, or restyle a video you have. The download is gated: add a Hugging Face token to your AI machine and accept the licence on its page first.
tryIt: A street drummer in the rain, crowd cheering, close-up on the sticks

s2v.output: A talking or singing video, 16 fps, as long as the sound (up to about 19 s)
s2v.about: Give it a photo of someone and a voice recording or a song: their lips, face and body move with it. Describe the scene to steer the moves.
tryIt: She sings softly to the camera, swaying, warm stage lights

vace.base: Wan 2.1 VACE 14B (fp16, run in fp8) + SAM 3.1
vace.output: The edited video, 16 fps, up to 5 s (extend: 4 s more)
vace.about: An all-in-one video editor. Replace: name a thing in the video and describe what goes there. Restyle: keep the motion, change the look. Extend: what happens next. Move a photo: a person from a photo moves like the video.
tryIt: Replace the red car with a white horse
Make it a watercolour painting

video-erase.output: The video without it, 16 fps, up to 5 s
video-erase.about: Type what to remove: SAM 3.1 finds it in every frame and VACE paints the background back in. Uses the same files as Wan VACE, so it is free once VACE is on your machine.
tryIt: the man in the red shirt
the watermark in the corner

person-swap.output: Your video with the new person in it, 16 fps, up to 5 s, with its sound
person-swap.speed: 6 steps; a few minutes for 5 seconds is expected, not measured yet
person-swap.about: Say who in your video to replace and add a photo of the new person (a face close-up helps): they take over in every frame, with the same moves, light and sound. Only the first frame needs to show who; the words find them there. Photos of real people are never made sexual, and children can't be swapped.
tryIt: the man in the red jacket
the woman on the left

video-sharpen.output: The same video, twice as large and sharper, with its sound
video-sharpen.about: A one-step video restorer: cleans up blur, noise and compression and doubles the size, frame by frame without flicker.

live-draw.publisher: Gaurav Parmar et al., CMU and Adobe (img2img-turbo)
live-draw.base: pix2pix-turbo (sketch to image) on Stability AI's SD-Turbo
live-draw.license: pix2pix-turbo code and LoRA: MIT. SD-Turbo weights: Stability AI Community License (free for personal use, research and businesses under US$1M a year; above that Stability AI needs to license it).
live-draw.output: A live preview of your drawing, 512 × 512, while you draw
live-draw.gpu: About 4–6 GB of the 48 GB while Live draw is open (an estimate, not measured yet); it unloads after 4 quiet minutes
live-draw.speed: One step per preview: meant to keep up with your pencil, but its speed on this machine has not been measured yet
live-draw.about: Draw with your Apple Pencil or finger and see a picture appear beside it as you draw. Say what it is in a few words; the slider sets how closely it follows your lines. When you like it, Finish makes a full-quality version with Sketch finish.
tryIt: a cat on a windowsill, oil painting
a lighthouse in a storm, watercolour

sketch-finish.output: A finished picture that follows your drawing's lines
sketch-finish.gpu: About 25–30 GB of the 48 GB (an estimate, not measured yet)
sketch-finish.speed: 8 steps at about a megapixel: under a minute is expected, not measured yet
sketch-finish.about: Finishes a Live draw sketch at full quality. Z-Image-Turbo makes the picture and a ControlNet keeps it on your lines (more with “Follow my lines”). The result goes into your gallery like any picture: the NSFW check, your marks and “Make it move” all work on it.
tryIt: a red fox in fresh snow, golden hour
a cosy cabin interior, children's book illustration

live-sdv2.publisher: Tianrui Feng, Chenfeng Xu et al. (UT Austin, UC Berkeley, MIT, Stanford)
live-sdv2.base: StreamDiffusionV2 (causal Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B, video to video)
live-sdv2.license: Apache 2.0 (code and weights; Wan 2.1 1.3B is Apache 2.0 too)
live-sdv2.output: Your camera or your drawing, restyled live by your words
live-sdv2.gpu: About 18–24 GB of the 48 GB while it runs (an estimate, not measured yet)
live-sdv2.speed: Not measured on this machine. Its makers publish speeds for bigger multi-GPU setups, not for one A40 or H100, so expect a few frames a second, maybe fewer
live-sdv2.about: Point the iPad's camera at something (or draw) and describe a look: the video comes back restyled while you watch, and you can change the words while it runs. “Save last 10 s” keeps the end of it in your gallery. Sets up its own Python the first time (a few minutes).
tryIt: a watercolour painting
a claymation character, stop motion

live-krea.license: Weights: Apache 2.0 (as listed on Hugging Face). Code: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so personal, non-commercial use only: don't use it for paid work or a business.
live-krea.output: A video from your words as it plays, or your camera or drawing restyled
live-krea.gpu: Needs 40 GB+: the Turbo machine (H100, 80 GB) only. It refuses to install on the Standard machine (48 GB)
live-krea.speed: Krea measured 11 frames a second on an NVIDIA B200. Not measured on the H100 here
live-krea.about: A 14-billion-parameter video model that makes video as it plays: type what should happen and change the words while it runs, or restyle your camera. About 30 GB of files plus its own Python. Turbo machine only, and for personal, non-commercial use only (its code's licence).
tryIt: a paper boat drifting down a rainy street, cinematic
a fox running through autumn leaves

canvas-fast.publisher: Gaurav Parmar et al. (img2img-turbo); Stability AI (SD-Turbo); Ollin Boer Bohan (TAESD)
canvas-fast.base: pix2pix-turbo (sketch to image) and SD-Turbo img2img, on Stability AI's SD-Turbo
canvas-fast.license: SD-Turbo: Stability AI Community License (free for personal use, research and businesses under US$1M a year after registering; not for studio members). pix2pix-turbo code and LoRA: MIT. TAESD: MIT.
canvas-fast.output: A picture under your strokes while you draw, in Live Draw
canvas-fast.gpu: About 6–8 GB while Live Draw is open (an estimate, not measured yet)
canvas-fast.speed: One step per picture: meant for 8–20 pictures a second at 512; not measured on the drawing machine yet
canvas-fast.about: The fast engine behind Live Draw: a sketch alone goes through pix2pix-turbo; with colour or a kept picture, SD-Turbo repaints the canvas as it looks in one step. Uses the same files as Live draw plus a tiny decoder.
tryIt: a cat on a windowsill, oil painting
a lighthouse in a storm, watercolour

canvas-licensed.publisher: Stability AI and Runway (SD 1.5); Latent Consistency (LCM-LoRA); Lvmin Zhang (ControlNet 1.1); Tencent AI Lab (IP-Adapter)
canvas-licensed.base: Stable Diffusion 1.5 + LCM-LoRA (4 steps) + ControlNet line art and openpose + IP-Adapter
canvas-licensed.license: SD 1.5: CreativeML OpenRAIL-M. LCM-LoRA: OpenRAIL++. ControlNet 1.1: OpenRAIL. IP-Adapter: Apache 2.0. TAESD: MIT. All allow commercial use (the OpenRAIL use restrictions pass on to whoever uses it).
canvas-licensed.output: A picture under your strokes while you draw, for studio members
canvas-licensed.gpu: About 6–9 GB while Live Draw is open (an estimate, not measured yet)
canvas-licensed.speed: Four steps per picture; not measured on the drawing machine yet
canvas-licensed.about: The engine studio members draw with in Live Draw: it follows your lines with ControlNet, takes a pose from the stick figure, and matches a style reference with IP-Adapter.
tryIt: a knight in shining armour, comic book
a cosy cabin in the woods, watercolour

canvas-reader.output: Up to three guesses of what your drawing is, each with words to make it
canvas-reader.gpu: About 2 GB once used (an estimate, not measured yet)
canvas-reader.speed: Under a second per drawing on the drawing machine (an estimate, not measured yet)
canvas-reader.about: The orb looks at your sketch and suggests what it is; tap a guess to use its words.
